shortDescription: Manage route domains on a BIG-IP

options.name: bwc_policy
options.description: The bandwidth controller for the route domain.

options.name: connection_limit
options.description: The maximum number of concurrent connections allowed for the route domain. Setting this to C(0) turns off connection limits.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies descriptive text that identifies the route domain.

options.name: flow_eviction_policy
options.description: The eviction policy to use with this route domain. Apply an eviction policy to provide customized responses to flow overflows and slow flows on the route domain.

options.name: fw_enforced_policy
options.description: Specifies an AFM policy to be attached to route domain. To remove attached AFM policy use C("") or C(none) as values.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifying integer representing the route domain. This field is required when creating a new route domain. In version 2.5, this value is no longer used to reference a route domain when making modifications to it (for instance during update and delete operations). Instead, the C(name) parameter is used. In version 2.6, the C(name) value will become a required parameter.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the route domain.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the route domain the system searches when it cannot find a route in the configured domain.

options.name: partition
options.description: Partition on which you want to create the route domain. Partitions cannot be updated once they are created.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: routing_protocol
options.description: Dynamic routing protocols for the system to use in the route domain.

options.name: service_policy
options.description: Service policy to associate with the route domain.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the route domain should exist or not.

options.name: strict
options.description: Specifies whether the system enforces cross-routing restrictions or not.

options.name: vlans
options.description: VLANs for the system to use in the route domain.
